annotation.authors_or_issuer: President of the Republic of Korea (Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport)
key_provisions_or_claims: Sets procedure for the national drone industry master plan led by the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport.
Establishes a consultative body on the drone industry (up to 20 members) with recusal and dismissal rules.
Prescribes application, requirements and designation procedures for drone special free zones, demonstration zones and drone parks.
Defines drone information system content, including military-zone security processing and Aviation Safety Act data.
Provides support for R&D, startups, IP protection, human resources training, overseas expansion, and entrustment of affairs.
annotation.summary_en: Korean Presidential Decree enforcing the Act on Promotion of Utilization of Drones and Creation of Infrastructure. It sets procedures for the drone industry master plan, consultative body, drone information system, special free zones, demonstration zones, drone parks, R&D and startup support, IP, training, and entrustment of affairs.
